"Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, for the faith of the chosen people of God and knowledge of the truth that agrees with godliness, "
"with the certain hope of eternal life that the non-lying God promised before all the ages of time. "
"But at the right time, he revealed his word by the proclamation, the one I was entrusted with by the command of God our Savior. "
"To Titus, a true son in a common faith. Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Savior. "
"For this purpose I left you in Crete, that you might set in order the things not yet being complete and ordain elders in every city as I directed you— "
"if anyone is blameless, a husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of reckless behavior or rebellion. "
"For the overseer must be blameless, as a household manager of God, not arrogant, not easily angered, not addicted to wine, not a brawler, not greedy. "
"Instead, he must be hospitable, a friend of what is good, sensible, righteous, holy, self-controlled. "
"He must hold tightly to the trustworthy message that is in accordance with the teaching, so that he may be able both to encourage others with sound teaching and to rebuke the ones opposing {him}. "
"For there are many rebellious people, empty talkers and deceivers, especially the ones from the circumcision. "
"It is necessary to stop them. They are upsetting whole households, teaching what they should not for the sake of shameful profit. "
"One of them, of their own prophets, has said, “Cretans {are} always liars, evil beasts, lazy bellies.” "
"This testimony is true. For this reason, rebuke them severely, so that they may be sound in the faith, "
"not paying any attention to Jewish myths or to commands of people turning away from the truth. "
"All things {are} pure to the ones {who are} pure. But to the ones having been corrupted and unbelieving, nothing {is} pure, but both their minds and consciences have been corrupted. "
"They profess to know God, but they deny {him} by their actions, being detestable and disobedient and unfit for any good work. "

"; that is, he does not have any other wives or concubines. This also means that he does not commit adultery and may also mean that he has not divorced a previous wife. Alternate translation: [a man who has only one woman] or [a man who is faithful to his wife]"
<div data-frame="6" data-i="choice" data-testid="helps-note" data-tone="accent" dir="ltr" role="button" tabindex="0" style=@3341312e2dcc>
"This could refer to: (1) children who believe in Jesus. Alternate translation: [children who are faithful to God]; (2) children who are trustworthy. Alternate translation: [children who are honest]"

"Paul speaks of the church as if it were God’s "

"Alternate translation: [not an alcoholic] or [not one who drinks much wine]"

"Alternate translation: [not one who is violent] or [not one who likes to fight]"

" introduce a goal or purpose relationship. The purpose for the elder to hold tightly to the trustworthy message is for him to be able to encourage others and rebuke those who oppose him. Use a connector in your language that makes it clear that this is a purpose. Alternate translation: [because in this way]"

" normally refers to being physically healthy. Paul is speaking of this "
" as if it were a living thing that could be healthy or sick. If it would be helpful in your language, you could state the meaning plainly. Alternate translation: [correct teaching]"

" is a metaphor for useless, and "
" are people who say useless or foolish things. Alternate translation: [people who say useless things]"

<div data-frame="10" data-i="choice" data-testid="helps-note" data-tone="accent" dir="ltr" role="button" tabindex="0" style=@3341312e2dcc>
" refer to the same people, those who are also "
". Those people taught false, worthless things and wanted other people to believe them. Alternate translation: [people who say wrong things so that others will believe things that are not true]"
<div data-frame="10" data-i="choice" data-testid="helps-note" data-tone="accent" dir="ltr" role="button" tabindex="0" style=@3341312e2dcc>

" represents the Jewish believers who taught that men must be circumcised in order to please God. This teaching is false. If it would be helpful in your language, you could state the meaning plainly. Alternate translation: [the ones who teach that men must be circumcised in order to please God]"
<div data-frame="11" data-i="choice" data-testid="helps-note" data-tone="accent" dir="ltr" role="button" tabindex="0" style=@3341312e2dcc>

"The implication is that these people must be stopped from teaching. You could include this information if that would be helpful to your readers. Alternate translation: [You must prevent them from spreading their false teachings] or [Someone must stop them from deceiving others by their words]"

", meaning that the activity of accepting money for teaching wrong things brings shame on the teacher. Consider how to express this in your language. Alternate translation: [and increasing their shame by taking money for it]"

" here is an overstatement for emphasis. If it would be helpful in your language, you could use a different way to express the emphasis. Alternate translation: [Cretans have a reputation to be liars] or [Cretans tend to be liars]"

". If it would be helpful in your language, you could state the meaning plainly. Alternate translation: [as dangerous as wild animals]"

"Here the part of the body that stores food is used to represent the person who eats all the time. If it would be helpful in your language, you could use an equivalent expression from your culture or state the meaning plainly. Alternate translation: [lazy gluttons] or [lazy people who just want to eat]"

"Alternate translation: [For that reason, you must use strong language that the Cretans will understand when you correct them]"

" introduce a reason-result relationship. " could refer to: (1) the Cretan believers in general. This seems likely since the "

"“so that they may be sound in the faith”"

", as well as what follows in verse 14, as the goal or purpose of rebuking the Cretans. Use a connector in your language that makes it clear that this is the purpose."

" represents the things that the people believe about God. Alternate translation: [in what they believe about God]"

"Paul speaks of the truth as if it were an object that one could turn away from or avoid. Alternate translation: [who reject the truth]"

"“All things are pure to the ones who are pure”"

"Here, Paul uses or invents a proverb in order to teach that being pure or pleasing to God is a matter of a person’s inward thoughts, not a matter of outward actions or rituals. Translate this proverb in a way that will be recognized as a proverb and be meaningful in your language and culture. Alternate translation: [If people are pure on the inside, everything that they do will be pure] or [When…"
<div data-frame="15" data-i="choice" data-testid="helps-note" data-tone="accent" dir="ltr" role="button" tabindex="0" style=@3341312e2dcc>
"Alternate translation: [to those who are acceptable to God]"
